public_sources: Dated official documented workflows; no authenticated competitor usability claims

local_checks.capture: Title, review, save and explicit Inbox destination
local_checks.reschedule: Separate plan/deadline fields; task moves from Inbox to Upcoming
local_checks.history: Complete, locate in Completed, restore without game effect
local_checks.calendar: October month day 18 selects Tomorrow agenda
local_checks.keyboard: Task-name autofocus, Tab to More options, Save autofocus, Escape closes editor

limitations: No actual virtual keyboard, safe area, mobile device or screen-reader qualification.
No consenting human usability feedback or authenticated competitor app session.
Prototype persistence, advanced project creation, recurrence authoring and sync error flows are placeholders.
No application UI task is accepted from prototype evidence.
